He promised me that a letter would be sent to the hospital so I could have some scans.

Due to no correspondence coming from this surgery other than to fill out surveys from Surveymonkey, I have to call repeatedly.
Most times nobody will answer the phone.
After no letter being sent I requested an emergency appointment and complained.
As soon as I complained I was given an emergency face to face appointment.
The doctor and receptionist apologized unreservedly and admitted my care was poor at this clinic. They promised me the letter would be sent as priority that day .
Almost two weeks later after another 5 calls to the clinic I am told that the letter still hasn't been sent. Doctor has given me no pain relief and does not know anything about my condition.
I cannot go to the hospital as I need a referral from a GP.

We wonder why the NHS is in a poor state and underfunded and then look at this clinic and you see your answer.

They do not care for you correctly.
They allow your condition to deteriorate and do not make the correct referrals to the hospital at the right time . This means that the cost of your care increases massively and the length of time you suffer and the time it takes for you to get well again increases which in turn shortens your life span.
They ignore the telephone.
The receptionists are rude .
They get prescriptions wrong all the time and seems like they alter your prescription without authorisation.
The doctors seem to lack knowledge and common sense.
The clinic is constantly empty but there are doctors and nurses there and yet they can never give you an appointment.

The NHS need to do something regarding this type of doctor service.

DO NOT USE THIS CLINIC.",null,[0,199]]]],[null,1688391122000000,1688391122000000,"2 years ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/14446289509454801848/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTktjMk42WTNSblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/14446289509454801848/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTktjMk42WTNSblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/14446289509454801848/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTktjMk42WTNSblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/14446289509454801848/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTktjMk42WTNSblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/14446289509454801848/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTktjMk42WTNSblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/14446289509454801848/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTktjMk42WTNSblJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,["en"],[["Thank you for your feedback.
